# Version 4.154.0
> **Documentation and m154** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Chrome m154 and ships XML documentation alongside NuGet packages. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source; review the corrected and removed enum members before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed** — CCC133 is corrected to CCC132 to match upstream HarfBuzz while retaining numeric value 132. Rename source references to CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is removed** — Aggregate Defined flag masks are not exposed because they are not independent options. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags your application requires.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m154 and incorporates current upstream bug and buffer upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **XML API documentation ships with packages** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with source documentation authored directly alongside the managed API. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the HarfBuzz source pinned by Skia, keeping the managed surface synchronized while excluding unsupported callback-heavy APIs.
